full_page.content:
c. 1946, November 26
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
FOSTCARD
"O all ye works of the Lord! Bless the Lord forever." Nov. 26th.
Dear Fr. M. Joachim,
God bless you and yours.
Have just written Fr. J. O'Donnell -- also answered cur poor sister-in-law. Thank God she and Florence too seem to be trying bravely to keep up -- following close (at least) to the straight narrow path -- the chalk-line to happiness.
Try and drop a card to poor Fr. O'Donnell. In his case, as I just wrote him, like everybody else's, it is the enemy of our souls that is always trying to minimize and to hide the surpassing advantages by which everyone of us are surrounded. God help us!
Love to E'd and all. -- Oremus pro invicem. Fr. Solanus, sinner
Laudetur Jeusus Christus!
